title: ASEAN, China miss 2026 deadline for South China Sea code | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: ASEAN, Pax Silica, Maria Ressa

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: ASEAN, China won’t meet 2026 deadline to finish South China Sea talks

blocks.text: The Philippines’ yearlong chairmanship of ASEAN will end without finishing the long-awaited Code of Conduct in the South China Sea.

items: Nearly 300 protesters arrested in Muntinlupa as ASEAN Summit opens

blocks.text: Police clash with protesters at Liwasang Bonifacio, as activists oppose Pax Silica and criticize US President Donald Trump, during the first day of the 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila.

items: Defense lists 4 more witnesses in Sara Duterte trial

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team is expected to present four more witnesses in her impeachment trial this week.

items: Another fuel price rollback on November 17

blocks.text: Fuel prices will go down again starting Tuesday, November 17, especially diesel and kerosene.

items: Maria Ressa on AI overreliance: ‘Don’t outsource the nuances’

blocks.text: Rappler CEO and Nobel Peace Prize laureate Maria Ressa warns that growing overreliance on artificial intelligence could weaken critical thinking and harm newsrooms. – Rappler.com
